desc: Measured phase voltage

name: MCC_ADC_TEMP_VM_RAW
desc: Raw Die temperature voltage and supply voltage monitoring value

desc: Raw analog values AIN1 and AIN0

name: MCC_ADC_AIN3_AIN2_RAW
desc: Raw analog values AIN3 and AIN2

name: MCC_ADC_I_GEN_CONFIG
desc: General configuration setup of the current ADCs

name: MCC_ADC_I0_CONFIG
desc: Current ADC channel 0 offset and scaling values

name: MCC_ADC_I1_CONFIG
desc: Current ADC channel 1 offset and scaling values

name: MCC_ADC_I2_CONFIG
desc: Current ADC channel 2 offset and scaling values

name: MCC_ADC_I3_CONFIG
desc: Current ADC channel 3 offset and scaling values

name: MCC_ADC_I1_I0_SCALED
desc: Phase current I1, I0; after applying scaling and offset.

name: MCC_ADC_I3_I2_SCALED
desc: Phase current I3, I2; after applying scaling and offset.

name: MCC_ADC_IWY_IUX
desc: Scaled current ADC value including signed added offset as input for the FOC.

name: MCC_ADC_IV
desc: Scaled current ADC value including signed added offset as input for the FOC.

name: MCC_ADC_STATUS
desc: ADC status flags

name: MCC_MOTOR_CONFIG
desc: Motor type configuration and number of pole pairs

name: MCC_MOTION_CONFIG
desc: Register for selection of ramp mode, motion mode and controller feedforward.

name: MCC_PHI_E_SELECTION
desc: Selection of phi resp. encoder source for rotor position angle phi_e that is used as the input for the FOC for commutation.

name: MCC_PHI_E
desc: Angle used for the inner FOC loop.

name: MCC_PWM_CONFIG
desc: PWM Configuration: Chopper Mode, Enable Space Vector, Enable Bridge, Y2 Source, Offset.

name: MCC_PWM_MAXCNT
desc: PWM counter maximum length register     PWM_MAXCNT           controls    the   PWM      frequency. Default      25kHz. PWM frequency = 120MHz / PWM_MAXCNT.

name: MCC_PWM_SWITCH_LIMIT
desc: Determines a threshold for switching from three phase current measurement to two phase in Auto Kirchhoff.

name: MCC_ABN_PHI_E_PHI_M
desc: ABN Decoder electrical angle PHI_E and mechanical angle PHI_M.

name: MCC_ABN_MODE
desc: ABN decoder configuration.

name: MCC_ABN_CPR
desc: Decoder counts per revolution (CPR). ABN_CPR_INV needs to be set as well (ABN_CPR_INV = 2^32 / ABN_CPR).

name: MCC_ABN_CPR_INV
desc: 2^32 divided by decoder counts per revolution. (ABN_CPR_INV = 2^32 / ABN_CPR).

name: MCC_ABN_COUNT
desc: Raw decoder count. The digital decoder engine counts modulo ABN_CPR.

name: MCC_ABN_COUNT_N
desc: ABN_COUNT latched on N pulse, when N pulse clears ABN_COUNT then ABN_COUNT_N is also 0.

name: MCC_ABN_PHI_E_OFFSET
desc: Offset for ABN_PHI_E.

name: MCC_HALL_MODE
desc: Hall decoder configuration.

name: MCC_HALL_DPHI_MAX
desc: Maximum dx for extrapolation (default for digital hall: (2^16)/6).

name: MCC_HALL_PHI_E_OFFSET
desc: Offset for electrical angle hall_phi_e of hall decoder.

name: MCC_HALL_COUNT
desc: Count of passed hall states.

name: MCC_HALL_PHI_E_EXTRAPOLATED_PHI_E
desc: Hall decoder electrical angle PHI_E.

name: MCC_HALL_POSITION_060_POSITION_000
desc: Position of the hall sensor.

name: MCC_HALL_POSITION_180_POSITION_120
desc: Position of the hall sensor.

name: MCC_HALL_POSITION_300_POSITION_240
desc: Position of the hall sensor.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_A_1
desc: Biquad velocity filter coefficient A_1.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_A_2
desc: Biquad velocity filter coefficient A_2.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_B_0
desc: Biquad velocity filter coefficient B_0.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_B_1
desc: Biquad velocity filter coefficient B_1.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_B_2
desc: Biquad velocity filter coefficient B_2.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_V_ENABLE
desc: Biquad velocity filter enable.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_A_1
desc: Biquad torque filter coefficient A_1.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_A_2
desc: Biquad torque filter coefficient A_2.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_B_0
desc: Biquad torque filter coefficient B_0.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_B_1
desc: Biquad torque filter coefficient B_1.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_B_2
desc: Biquad torque filter coefficient B_2.

name: MCC_BIQUAD_T_ENABLE
desc: Biquad torque filter enable.

name: MCC_VELOCITY_CONFIG
desc: Velocity meter configuration.

name: MCC_VELOCITY_SCALING
desc: Scaling factor for velocity meter output. This value is only used when VELOCITY_FREQ in MCC_VELOCITY_CONFIG - METER_TYPE is selected.

name: MCC_V_MIN_POS_DEV_TIME_COUNTER_LIMIT
desc: Velocity meter configuration. These values are only used when VELOCITY_PER in MCC_VELOCITY_CONFIG - METER_TYPE is selected.

name: MCC_MAX_VEL_DEVIATION
desc: Velocity deviation to generate tracking error flag.

name: MCC_POSITION_CONFIG
desc: Position configuration

name: MCC_MAX_POS_DEVIATION
desc: Absolute position deviation to generate tracking error flag.

name: MCC_RAMPER_STATUS
desc: Ramp status and switch event status flags

name: MCC_RAMPER_A1
desc: First acceleration value during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_A2
desc: Second acceleration value during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_A_MAX
desc: Maximum acceleration value in top part of EigthPoint ramp

name: MCC_RAMPER_D1
desc: Lower deceleration value during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_D2
desc: Higher deceleration value in EigthPoint ramp

name: MCC_RAMPER_D_MAX
desc: Deceleration in top part of EightPoint ramp

name: MCC_RAMPER_V_START
desc: First velocity value during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_V1
desc: First velocity value for ac-/deceleration value switching during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_V2
desc: Second velocity value for ac-/deceleration value switching during EigthPoint ramp mode

name: MCC_RAMPER_V_STOP
desc: Stop Velocity in EightPoint Ramp.

name: MCC_RAMPER_V_MAX
desc: Maximum velocity value for positioning in EightPoint ramp

name: MCC_RAMPER_V_TARGET
desc: Target velocity value in EightPoint ramp

name: MCC_RAMPER_SWITCH_MODE
desc: Ramper mode configuration bits

name: MCC_RAMPER_TIME_CONFIG
desc: Ramper timing configuration.

name: MCC_RAMPER_A_ACTUAL
desc: Actual ramp acceleration value

name: MCC_RAMPER_X_ACTUAL
desc: Actual multi-turn position of ramp controller.

name: MCC_RAMPER_V_ACTUAL
desc: Actual velocity of Ramp controller output.

name: MCC_RAMPER_X_TARGET
desc: Multi-turn target position of Ramp controller.

name: MCC_RAMPER_PHI_E
desc: PHI_E of ramp controller.

name: MCC_RAMPER_PHI_E_OFFSET
desc: Offset value for calculation of RAMPER_PHI_E

name: MCC_RAMPER_ACC_FF
desc: Gain and shift factor for Acc. feedforward.

name: MCC_RAMPER_X_ACTUAL_LATCH
desc: Latches RAMPER_X_ACTUAL on left or right switch or Encoder trigger.

name: MCC_POSITION_ACTUAL_LATCH
desc: Latches PID_POSITION_ACTUAL on left or right switch or Encoder trigger.

name: MCC_PRBS_AMPLITUDE
desc: Set the amplitude of the PRBS signal used by some settings of MCC_MOTION_CONFIG -> MOTION_MODE. The output PRBS signal is either +PRBS_AMPLITUDE or -PRBS_AMPLITUDE. Setting this value to 0 resets the random sequence. After resetting the random sequence is always the same.

name: MCC_PRBS_DOWN_SAMPLING_RATIO
desc: Set downsampling rate of PWM frequency to trigger new PRBS value generation.

name: MCC_PID_CONFIG
desc: PI controller configuration.

name: MCC_PID_FLUX_COEFF
desc: Configuration of the PI Flux controller gains.

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_COEFF
desc: Configuration of the PI Torque controller gains.

name: MCC_PID_FIELDWEAK_COEFF
desc: Configuration of the PI Fieldweakening controller gains.

name: MCC_PID_U_S_MAX
desc: Maximum voltage allowed for fieldweakening. Target value of field weakening PI controller.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_COEFF
desc: Configuration of the PI Velocity controller gains.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_COEFF
desc: Configuration of the PI Position controller gains.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_TOLERANCE
desc: Position controller ignores position errors smaller than PID_POSITION_TOLERANCE if EVENT_POS_REACHED and after (PID_POSITION_TOLERANCE_DELAY × PWM period).

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_TOLERANCE_DELAY
desc: Number of PWM periods the abs(PID_POSITION_ERROR) must stay within PID_POSITION_TOLERANCE after EVENT_POS_REACHED to disable the controller.

name: MCC_PID_UQ_UD_LIMITS
desc: Set maximum output voltage limit value.

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_FLUX_LIMITS
desc: Set maximum target absolute current for torque and flux PI controller.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_LIMIT
desc: Set maximum absolute velocity for velocity PI controller.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_LIMIT_LOW
desc: Set minimum target position for position PI controller.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_LIMIT_HIGH
desc: Set maximum target position for position PI controller.

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_FLUX_TARGET
desc: PID target torque and target flux (for torque mode).

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_FLUX_OFFSET
desc: PID torque and flux offset.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_TARGET
desc: PID Target velocity (for velocity mode).

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_OFFSET
desc: PID velocity offset for feed forward control.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_TARGET
desc: Target position register (for position mode).

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_FLUX_ACTUAL
desc: PID actual torque and flux.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_ACTUAL
desc: PID actual velocity.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_ACTUAL
desc: PID actual position.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_ACTUAL_OFFSET
desc: Offset for actual position.

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_ERROR
desc: PID torque error.

name: MCC_PID_FLUX_ERROR
desc: PID flux error.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_ERROR
desc: PID velocity error.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_ERROR
desc: PID position error.

name: MCC_PID_TORQUE_INTEGRATOR
desc: PID torque Integrator.

name: MCC_PID_FLUX_INTEGRATOR
desc: PID flux Integrator.

name: MCC_PID_VELOCITY_INTEGRATOR
desc: PID velocity Integrator.

name: MCC_PID_POSITION_INTEGRATOR
desc: PID position Integrator.

name: MCC_PIDIN_TORQUE_FLUX_TARGET
desc: PID target torque and target flux for readback.

name: MCC_PIDIN_VELOCITY_TARGET
desc: PID target velocity for readback.

name: MCC_PIDIN_POSITION_TARGET
desc: PID target position for readback.

name: MCC_PIDIN_TORQUE_FLUX_TARGET_LIMITED
desc: PID target torque and target flux after PID_TORQUE_FLUX_LIMITS applied.

name: MCC_PIDIN_VELOCITY_TARGET_LIMITED
desc: PID target velocity after PID_VELOCITY_LIMIT applied.

name: MCC_PIDIN_POSITION_TARGET_LIMITED
desc: PID target position after PID_POSITION_LIMIT_LOW and PID_POSITION_LIMIT_HIGH applied.

name: MCC_FOC_IBETA_IALPHA
desc: Interim result of the FOC, IALPHA, and IBETA term.

name: MCC_FOC_IQ_ID
desc: Interim result of the FOC, ID, and IQ term.

name: MCC_FOC_UQ_UD
desc: Interim result of the FOC, UD, and UQ term.

name: MCC_FOC_UQ_UD_LIMITED
desc: Interim result of the FOC, UD, and UQ term. After PID_UQ_UD_LIMITS applied.

name: MCC_FOC_UBETA_UALPHA
desc: Interim result of the FOC, UALPHA, and UBETA term.

name: MCC_FOC_UWY_UUX
desc: Interim result of the FOC, UUX, and UWY term.

name: MCC_FOC_UV
desc: Interim result of the FOC, UV term.

name: MCC_PWM_VX2_UX1
desc: Interim result PWM duty cycle UX1 and VX2.

name: MCC_PWM_Y2_WY1
desc: Interim result PWM duty cycle WY1 and Y2.

name: MCC_VELOCITY_FRQ
desc: Actual velocity measured by fixed frequency sampling.

name: MCC_VELOCITY_PER
desc: Actual velocity measured by period measurement.

name: MCC_U_S_ACTUAL_I_S_ACTUAL
desc: Actual motor voltage and current.

name: MCC_P_MOTOR
desc: Actual Power applied to motor (P = U×I).

name: MCC_INPUTS_RAW
desc: Raw input signals PWM_IN, DIR, STP, Digital Hall Inputs, and digital ABN encoder inputs as raw signals for direct read out for system setup and validation during development phase.

name: MCC_OUTPUTS_RAW
desc: Raw output signals for each PWM channel high- and low-side.

name: MCC_STATUS_FLAGS
desc: Status Flag BitVector Vector, individual status bits are set to '1' on error condition pulse '1' and remain '1' until they are cleared through register access; error condition '1' have priority over register write to clear access.

name: MCC_GDRV_HW
desc: Controls the general gate driver setup.

name: MCC_GDRV_CFG
desc: Controls the gate driver behavior and current settings.

name: MCC_GDRV_TIMING
desc: Sets the T_DRIVE sink and source times for all channels.

name: MCC_GDRV_BBM
desc: Controls the BBM_L and BBM_H times for all channels.

name: MCC_GDRV_PROT
desc: Contains the general and VGS related protection settings.

name: MCC_GDRV_OCP_UVW
desc: Configures the overcurrent protection for phases U, V and W.

name: MCC_GDRV_OCP_Y2
desc: Configures the overcurrent protection for phase Y2.

name: MCC_GDRV_PROT_EN
desc: Enables the protection mechanism for the different fault events, note that the fault needs to be set in MCC_GDRV_STATUS_EN too.

name: MCC_GDRV_STATUS_EN
desc: Enables the reporting of the different fault events. Required to be activated to get any feedback of the fault status and enable the internal protections.

name: MCC_GDRV_STATUS
desc: Contains the status of the different fault events.

name: MCC_GDRV_FAULT
desc: Contains the status of the different fault events.

name: MCC_ADC_I1_I0_EXT
desc: External writable ADC value for phase I1, I0

name: MCC_ADC_I2_EXT
desc: External writable ADC value for phase I2. Note that depending on the selection in register MCC_ADC_I_GEN_CONFIG -> TRIGGER_SELECT, writing to this register may not trigger a new processing of the ADC data. So when updating all three external ADC values, it is recommended to update this register first.

name: MCC_PWM_VX2_UX1_EXT
desc: External writable PWM value.

name: MCC_PWM_Y2_WY1_EXT
desc: External writable PWM value.

name: MCC_PWM_EXT_Y2_ALT
desc: External writable PWM compare value for phase Y2_ALT.

name: MCC_VOLTAGE_EXT
desc: External writable parameter for open-loop voltage control mode, useful during system setup.

name: MCC_PHI_EXT
desc: Angle phi_e_ext and phi_m_ext for external writing into this register.

name: MCC_VELOCITY_EXT
desc: Actual velocity for external override.

name: FAULT_STS
desc: General system status flags. Bits are set and cleared automatically.

name: FAULT_R_INT
desc: General system status flags. Bits are set automatically if corresponding bit in FAULT_STS is set. Each bit must be cleared manually.

name: FAULT_R_ENA_F
desc: Mask for register FAULT_R_INT. If any bit in this mask register is set and the corresponding flag in the FAULT_R_INT register is also set, the status can be seen at the FAULTN pin.

name: ADC_SRC_CONFIG
desc: ADC sources config

name: ADC_SETUP
desc: ADC setup

name: ADC_STATUS
desc: ADC status bits

name: CSA_SETUP
desc: CSA setup
